notes: P6.1 OF SYSTEM-BROWSER-SPEC §2, THE STRONGEST OF THE FIVE, AND THE SECOND TO SHIP. Browse the image AS OF a commit or an instant: the class list, the method source — and the part that is genuinely new, senders and implementors computed at that point. IT IS NOT A RECONSTRUCTION. The image is a fold over an append-only commit log (5.129.0) rather than a mutable heap snapshot, so the image as it was is the same fold run over fewer records. Squeak and Pharo images are opaque binary blobs, and Squeak's changes file is a replay log no browser reads as a dimension. A CUT IS A BOUND, NEVER A FILTER, A
